questions.prompt: Compare one visual reaction time from Level 1 or 2 with one auditory reaction time from Level 3. Label each level and value in seconds, calculate or estimate the difference, and state which was faster (or whether they were about the same). questions.prompt: Compare one Level 2 drag race with one Level 3 sprint. For each trial, cite the two reaction times OR the recorded/calculated finish gap, using seconds for times and meters for gaps. Explain why the earlier dragster stays faster at the same clock time even with equal acceleration. Then explain what happens to the lead after both constant-speed sprinters start. Connect each explanation to your trial evidence.
